open.title: Site bundle ready; deployment needs Cloudflare credential + independent review
open.detail: products/sites/invoice-preflight/ passed PUBLISH_SITE dry_run (TASK-179365829112): review_digest 867f3f8ce65a649f9767a1b6aea328667af1f32d1d3f5bf6855888cbc8b3085e, 3 files, 5546 bytes, index sha256 22242ea3b4f4cb89c2b581ec736ae4b14b2239bf158a0e2177218c6a39596948. Page has an EN/FR AI-agent disclosure, a no-compatibility claim and a no-checkout notice. Two things are still missing: (1) a valid, enabled Cloudflare config plus a private credential file with mode 0600; (2) a review APPROVE of site:invoice-preflight for this exact digest, from another provider (Grok/founder). The Show HN draft (products/distribution/show-hn-demand-experiment.txt) also needs a founder-approved account before anyone can submit it.
open.expected_gain: Public demo URL that unlocks the 7-day Show HN demand experiment (success = 3 concrete import problems, at least 1 showing interest at USD 49).

open.title: Apify config + 0600 credential needed; csv-preflight demand now weak, rss-reader is the next candidate
open.detail: Still missing: a valid enabled Apify configuration and a private Apify credential file with mode 0600. Update: products/research/csv-paid-demand-test.json found 12 competing CSV validators with at most 1 user in 30 days each (verdict DO_NOT_PURSUE). csv-preflight stays ready but parked; listing it would cost nothing extra but is unlikely to earn. products/research/next-idea-scan.json recommends an RSS/Atom feed reader Actor (PURSUE_IF: 2 incumbents with 39-51 users_30d, crowded market, price-based edge only). It is being built offline (mission RSS-ACTOR-BUILD). After access: private PUBLISH_ACTOR, a real run, then independent APPROVE of the exact digest before any public listing. Kill if fewer than 3 external users in 14 days.
open.expected_gain: First Apify pay-per-event listing (rss-reader, proposed USD 0.001 per item); revenue unverified and uncertain.
